:= by
  have h1 : disjointed f (i + 1) = ⋃ j < i + 1, f j := rfl
  have h2 : (partialSups f) i = ⨆ j < i, f j := rfl
  have h3 : disjoint (disjointed f (i + 1)) (f (i + 1)) :=
    disjointed_disjoint_self f (i + 1)
  have h4 : (disjointed f (i + 1)) \ f (i + 1) = ⋃ j < i + 1, f j \ f (i + 1) :=
    by rw [h1, diff_eq]; exact rfl
  have h5 : ⋃ j < i + 1, f j \ f (i + 1) = (⋃ j < i, f j) \ f (i + 1) :=
    by rw [union_sdiff_right]; exact rfl
  rw [h1, h2, h4, h5]
  exact rfl
